Bienvenidos a mi Blog! 

Married since 2006, we are now a family of 4! 

My family is rapidly growing! 

I am Blessed. 
I am Christian/Catholic. {I love God & we strive every day to live by His word and in His image, but I will warn you…we are NOT perfect.} 
I’m a Hispanic Momma with a Hispanic Hubby. {Mexican-American to be exact} 
I love to live, laugh and play in the sun…{Mostly with my family} 
When we can, we love to travel. 
I use this Blog to chronicle our life together, our blessings & prayers, our big & little accomplishments, our adventures, even our failures, and lots of fun pictures! 
This has become my creative connection to the world and an experience of growth. 
Please join me on this little journey I like to call, Life!

Hi! We are: Margaret, Penelope, Bastian & Jon ~ My PB & J

We discovered that Penelope was allergic to MILK when she was only 9 months old. We always had a suspicion since she was born that there was something up. A few months later we discovered that she was allergic to EGGS as well. It is extremely challenging living with these allergies, as most kid foods consist of MILK & EGGS. Penelope''s allergy is so severe that just going to the grocery store or even the toy store, she can show symptoms, i.e. hives, itching, sneezing and with no obvious trigger (we always suspect it could be milk residue on the cart? But we''re never sure). It''s hard. It''s frustrating. Due to this, we don''t really go out too often, as the fear of a serious reaction is always in the back of our minds. 

But we like to have fun in other ways!
